description: This file contains Redux reducer functions for managing plugin-related state in the Mattermost web application, including plugin manifests, components, admin console customizations, and user settings.

methods.name: hasMenuId
methods.description: Recursively checks if a menu or its submenus contain a specific menu ID.

methods.name: buildMenu
methods.description: Recursively constructs a menu tree by adding a submenu item at the correct parent menu.

methods.name: sortComponents
methods.description: Sorts components based on pluginId alphabetically.

methods.name: removePostPluginComponents
methods.description: Removes post type components associated with a specific plugin ID from the state.

methods.name: removePostPluginComponent
methods.description: Removes a specific post type component by ID from the state.

methods.name: removePluginComponents
methods.description: Removes plugin components associated with a specific plugin ID from the state.

methods.name: removePluginComponent
methods.description: Removes a plugin component by ID from the state.

methods.name: plugins
methods.description: Reducer managing the collection of plugin manifests.

methods.name: adminConsoleReducers
methods.description: Reducer managing admin console reducers for plugins.

methods.name: adminConsoleCustomComponents
methods.description: Reducer managing custom admin console components per plugin.

methods.name: adminConsoleCustomSections
methods.description: Reducer managing custom admin console sections per plugin.

methods.name: siteStatsHandlers
methods.description: Reducer managing plugin system console stats handlers.
